snippet.title: PlayStation - Pocke-Kano - Fumio Ueno (1999) - Intro
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Pocke-Kano: Fumio Ueno is a Strategy game, developed and published by Datam Polystar, which was released in Japan in 1999.
